Inventory & Warehouse Management – Conducted safety audits of central store warehouse of Guwahati refinery, Hydrocarbon storage facilities in tank farms, hazardous material handling, and ensured compliance with safety regulations. Production & Operations – Led PHA, HAZOP, risk assessments, and operational safety inspections to ensure safe and efficient production processes. Process Safety – Extensive experience in LOPA, QRA, HAZOP, PSSR, and MOC processes, ensuring risk mitigation and compliance with safety standards. Maintenance & Asset Integrity – Planned safety compliance for maintenance outages, Plant Shutdown / turnaround, conducted, and ensured safe equipment operations after Management of Change and Pre-start up Safety Review. Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) – Led incident investigations, root cause analysis (RCA), HSE audits, and site inspections to enhance workplace safety and regulatory compliance. Engineering Management – Conducted safety reviews for engineering projects like EURO-VI projject, ensured compliance with technical documentation, and supported operational risk assessments. Laboratory Operations – Conducted safety audits for chemical handling, laboratory risk assessments, and compliance monitoring. Ensured HSE compliance and performance at the site level, adhering to international standards. Provided advice and consultation to department staff to maintain a safe working environment. Conducted Job Safety Analysis (JSA) and Risk Assessments, identified and evaluated hazardous conditions, and developed controls for identified hazards. Coordinated on-site inspections to audit physical conditions and safe work practices, provided recommendations for corrective actions and prepared detailed reports. Developed and delivered safety orientations and specialised HSE training programs, including hazard control information and new employee orientations. M

M Competence Very good expertise in Data Analytics techniques. Please	provide	details/examples	of expertise. The candidate has utilized data-driven techniques in risk assessment and safety audits, leveraging tools like BowTie XP and ALOHA for predictive safety modeling. The candidate has extensive experience using Excel for data analysis, reporting, and trend analysis related to HSE metrics and safety audits. Examples: Near Miss Analysis: Categorized and analyzed near-miss reports at Guwahati Refinery to identify trends and implement preventive actions to mitigate potential major incidents. Audit & Safety Drill Insights: Conducted trend analysis on audit recommendations, mock drill observations, and safety tour findings to gain a comprehensive understanding of recurring safety concerns and develop targeted corrective actions. Compliance & Performance Tracking: Maintained and analyzed HSE compliance data, tracking safety KPI performance to support continuous improvement initiatives in process safety and risk management. I was also lead training resource for yPMS – Permit Management System which is part of Material Management module in SAP ERP for Guwahati Refinery. Provide examples of types of reports prepared. The candidate has extensive experience in producing detailed audit report, incident investigation reports, and compliance assessments, ensuring clarity and actionable recommendations. Examples of report prepared: Monthly and quarterly safety reports for Guwahati Refinery to Refineries Headquarters (RHQ) at IOCL. Reports for Cross Refinery Safety Audits which have findings of the audits with evidence of audits, observations of the site, documents and non-compliance/non-conformity and recommendations. Member of the multi-disciplinary team for internal safety audit and system audit to identify gaps in the safety management system and ensure continual improvement. e Communication Excellent interpersonal and interviewing skills, including the ability to interact with all levels of management and employees. Provide examples of levels of management and employees that have been interacted with in the past. The candidate has engaged with all levels of management, including senior leadership, site supervisors, engineering leads, and regulatory auditors, to ensure adherence to safety standards and regulatory compliance. Senior Management Interaction: Actively participated in Monthly Safety Committee Meetings, chaired by the Executive Director and Refinery Head, alongside Chief General Managers, General Managers, and Heads of Departments (HODs). Regularly represented the safety department, delivering presentations on refinery safety performance. Site-Level Engagement: Led monthly sectional safety meetings with site supervisors and technicians, reviewing safety performance across 12 units of Guwahati Refinery and addressing key safety concerns. Regulatory Liaison: Served as the department’s primary liaison during external audits conducted by government regulatory bodies, including the Oil Industry Safety Directorate (OISD) and the Petroleum and Explosive Safety Organisation (PESO), ensuring full compliance with industry safety regulations. Experience in material procurement from initial stage of spec finalisation , raising purchase requisition, tender evaluation, inspection for quality assurance, contractor management, and inventory management. Inventory & Warehouse Management – Conducted safety audits of central store warehouse of Guwahati refinery, Hydrocarbon storage facilities in tank farms, hazardous material handling, and ensured compliance with safety regulations. Production & Operations – Led PHA, HAZOP, risk assessments, and operational safety inspections to ensure safe and efficient production processes. Process Safety – Extensive experience in LOPA, QRA, HAZOP, PSSR, and MOC processes, ensuring risk mitigation and compliance with safety standards. Maintenance & Asset Integrity – Planned safety compliance for maintenance outages, Plant Shutdown / turnaround, conducted, and ensured safe equipment operations after Management of Change and Pre-start up Safety Review. Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) – Led incident investigations, root cause analysis (RCA), HSE audits, and site inspections to enhance workplace safety and regulatory compliance. Engineering Management – Conducted safety reviews for engineering projects like EURO-VI projject, ensured compliance with technical documentation, and supported operational risk assessments. Laboratory Operations – Conducted safety audits for chemical handling, laboratory risk assessments, and compliance monitoring. Ensured HSE compliance and performance at the site level, adhering to international standards. Provided advice and consultation to department staff to maintain a safe working environment. Conducted Job Safety Analysis (JSA) and Risk Assessments, identified and evaluated hazardous conditions, and developed controls for identified hazards. Coordinated on-site inspections to audit physical conditions and safe work practices, provided recommendations for corrective actions and prepared detailed reports. Developed and delivered safety orientations and specialised HSE training programs, including hazard control information and new employee orientations. Led incident investigations with a multi-disciplinary team and presented reports with RCA and recommendations, Outcome extracted and shared learnings across the organisation. Ensured emergency preparedness and coordinated effective drills against identified scenarios. Participated in and organised yearly internal audit plans. Actively promoted HSEQ culture within the work premises covering various stakeholders. Behavioral Good judgment and analytical skills (big picture) Please provide examples. The candidate has demonstrated strong analytical skills in conducting risk assessments, root cause analysis, and hazard study facilitation for high-risk operations in oil and gas facilities. Examples: Audit and Compliance Review: Analyzed findings from safety audits, mock drills, and safety observation visits, providing insights that helped refine safety policies and risk management strategies. Process Safety Risk Assessment: Conducted root cause analysis (RCA) and hazard studies (HAZOP, LOPA, QRA), ensuring that operational risks were systematically identified and mitigated. Strategic Safety Decision Making: Provided data driven safety performance reports to senior management, supporting decision-making on resource allocation and process improvements for enhanced safety culture. M
Behavioral Strong organizational skills (scheduling meetings, adequate and timely working papers). Please elaborate / provide examples. The candidate has demonstrated strong organizational skills by effectively scheduling meetings, coordinating safety initiatives, and ensuring timely documentation of safety reports and audit findings. Examples: Led Sectional Safety Committee Meetings (SSCM) attended by Plant Managers along with associated maintenance team and technicians, ensuring structured discussions on safety performance and compliance. Scheduled and coordinated Safety Observation Visits (SOVs) conducted by top management, tracking findings and ensuring timely resolution of identified hazards. Prepared and managed timely reports for safety audits, accident investigations, and compliance reviews, ensuring prompt action and documentation. M Behavioral Ability to work independently with minimum instructions and supervision from the Lead Auditor. Has (s)he led many assignments before? Size of assignments that were led. The candidate has led and coordinated multiple HSE audits, scheduled risk assessments, ensured compliance with safety regulations, and managed timely reporting of safety performance indicators. M Competence Very good expertise in Data Analytics techniques. Please	provide	details/examples	of expertise. The candidate has utilized data-driven techniques in risk assessment and safety audits, leveraging tools like BowTie XP and ALOHA for predictive safety modeling. P Competence Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel Provide examples in support of response. The candidate has extensive experience using Excel for data analysis, reporting, and trend analysis related to HSE metrics and safety audits. Examples: Near Miss Analysis: Categorized and analyzed near-miss reports at Guwahati Refinery to identify trends and implement preventive actions to mitigate potential major incidents. Audit & Safety Drill Insights: Conducted trend analysis on audit recommendations, mock drill observations, and safety tour findings to gain a comprehensive understanding of recurring safety concerns and develop targeted corrective actions. Compliance & Performance Tracking: Maintained and analyzed HSE compliance data, tracking safety KPI performance to support continuous improvement initiatives in process safety and risk management. P Competence Good knowledge and use of SAP ERP system The candidate has 6 years of extensive knowledge of various modules of SAP ERP system such as MM module for Material Procumbent, Inventory management, departmental budgeting and work permit system. I was also lead training resource for yPMS – Permit Management System which is part of Material Management module in SAP ERP for Guwahati Refinery. P Communication Strong written and oral communication skills (in English). This includes the ability to prepare high quality Audit Memos with recommendations. Provide examples of types of reports prepared. The candidate has extensive experience in producing detailed audit report, incident investigation reports, and compliance assessments, ensuring clarity and actionable recommendations. Examples of report prepared: Monthly and quarterly safety reports for Guwahati Refinery to Refineries Headquarters (RHQ) at IOCL. Reports for Cross Refinery Safety Audits which have findings of the audits with evidence of audits, observations of the site, documents and non-compliance/non-conformity and recommendations. Member of the multi-disciplinary team for internal safety audit and system audit to identify gaps in the safety management system and ensure continual improvement. e Communication Excellent interpersonal and interviewing skills, including the ability to interact with all levels of management and employees. Provide examples of levels of management and employees that have been interacted with in the past. The candidate has engaged with all levels of management, including senior leadership, site supervisors, engineering leads, and regulatory auditors, to ensure adherence to safety standards and regulatory compliance. Senior Management Interaction: Actively participated in Monthly Safety Committee Meetings, chaired by the Executive Director and Refinery Head, alongside Chief General Managers, General Managers, and Heads of Departments (HODs). Regularly represented the safety department, delivering presentations on refinery safety performance. Site-Level Engagement: Led monthly sectional safety meetings with site supervisors and technicians, reviewing safety performance across 12 units of Guwahati Refinery and addressing key safety concerns. Regulatory Liaison: Served as the department’s primary liaison during external audits conducted by government regulatory bodies, including the Oil Industry Safety Directorate (OISD) and the Petroleum and Explosive Safety Organisation (PESO), ensuring full compliance with industry safety regulations.
